decided: When a decision record is reworded by a new record that replaces it, the links the old record held (the stop it named, what it relied on) are copied as they were, and orbit accepts them even if what they point at has itself been replaced since; a stop that was answered keeps that one answer even after the stop is reworded.
alternatives: make the rewording record point each link at the newest version of what it points at, and compare links by what they point at rather than by their exact text
why: Rewording must never change what happened, so the links stay exactly as first written; without this, a record whose stop had been reworded could never be reworded itself, and a reworded stop could be answered twice.
detail: Proposal walk of fresh pass W1 / external W3 and W4, option A1; orbit-decision-records `A record is fixed by a replacement, never edited`.
